title: Soemba, N.E.I., 1:100,000 – blad 77/XLVIII , HIND

series.title: Soemba, N.E.I., 1:100,000
series.notes: Topographic map series of Sumba Island, Indonesia showing roads, tracks, footpaths, boundaries, water features, vegetation, cultivation, swamps, buildings and built-up areas. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. | Based on "Netherlands East Indies, southern zone grid". Includes "Incidence of grid letters and index to adjoining sheets"; Legend on some maps includes abbreviations and Dutch-English translations. | Sheets of various editions. Later maps published by the Survey Directorate, H.Q. ALFSEA, with standard series designation: Hind 638. Sheets Waikaboebak and Tossi: "Prepared

creator: United States. Army. Office of the Chief of Engineers, cartographer, issuing body.
